abruptProcessExit.method: Child Node.js process calls process.exit(86) at an exact protocol stage. A later process performs recovery.
abruptProcessExit.result: All nine abrupt process-exit stage tests passed.

authorityBoundary.statement: Persistence validates and selects complete world snapshots. Snapshot files, candidate roles, generations, and persistence receipts do not create canonical rules.

claimBoundary: This is process-exit recovery evidence on the tested GitHub Actions Ubuntu filesystem, not universal sudden power-loss proof.
AFTER_TEMP_WRITE occurs before temp-file fsync; the test shows survival after process exit only.
Storage-controller caches, hardware failure, and torn writes below the filesystem are not tested.
Behavior on every operating system, filesystem, network filesystem, or cross-device path is not established.
No single-writer lock, lease, fencing token, or compare-and-swap admission gate exists yet.
Immediate parent linkage is recorded, but complete historical lineage verification is not implemented.
No one-step transaction yet binds world mutation, scheduler queue, mailbox, compaction journal, and durable generation admission.
No atomic persistence performance claim is established.
